room.note: VERIFY: 3% agree is confirmed; fill disagree / neither shares and the under-30 n from Pew's chart. Reveal note to keep: a Dec 2023 opt-in online poll reported 20% of under-30s agreeing; Pew re-asked it on its probability panel and found 3%, and traced the gap to bogus respondents (in a 2022 test, 12% of opt-in under-30s claimed to be licensed to operate a nuclear submarine).
